name: DynamicEarthNet: Daily PlanetScope Multi-Spectral Satellite Time-Series
description: DynamicEarthNet is a daily multi-spectral satellite benchmark for monitoring Earth surface dynamics over time. Covering 75 areas of interest (AOIs) of 9 km² each across all seven continents, it provides daily 3-meter resolution PlanetScope imagery (4 bands: RGB and Near-Infrared) collected continuously over two full years (2018–2019, totaling over 55,000 observations). The dataset includes monthly pixel-level semantic change segmentation masks annotated across 7 land use and land cover (LULC) classes to evaluate spatio-temporal change detection and multi-temporal segmentation.
